plain: Shockingly obvious and bad, impossible to overlook

webster.text: Burning; ardent; eager; as flagrant desires.

more.text: Flaming in notice; glaring; notorious; enormous; as a flagrant crime.

example.quote: Ingratitude is a common topic of declamation against human nature; and it must be confessed that instances of it are but too frequent and flagrant, both in public and in private life.
